h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תֵצֵא, י״א Ki Seitzei, 11
Oral Torah Restores Splendor in the Millennium of Desolation

p: In the Ra'aya Mehemna on this parsha (Zohar III 282a):
"And it brought about that of the Queen
'He has made me desolate, all the day faint';
Hod (splendor) was turned into davah (faintness)," etc.
who touched the left thigh of Yaakov,
'He has made me desolate, all the day faint';
Hod, from the side of Hod:
At first glance it is not understood
that he touched the left thigh of Yaakov;
for there is no one who holds
that he touched specifically the left one:
he made him forget it in the right one,
and according to the Rabbanan he came from behind him
and made him forget it in both
that he touched the left thigh of Yaakov?
Moshe Rabbeinu is the attribute of Netzach,
and Aharon the attribute of Hod, on the left.
meaning that he wanted to accuse
does not belong to Yisrael, Heaven forbid,
but rather that they are the eternal ones;
"And reason decides in favor of the right one,"
(and it was explained in Parshas Shoftim).
which corresponds to the attribute of Netzach
for the six thousand years that the world exists
correspond to the six days of Creation,
is the day that is entirely Shabbos,
and they correspond to the seven attributes,
and the Second Temple stood in it
And this is what is said
in the Ra'aya Mehemna mentioned above:
"that he touched the left thigh of Yaakov,
'He has made me desolate, all the day faint'";
for Hod was turned into davah, Heaven forbid.
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קטז, ב)
And so it writes in the holy Zohar (I 116b):
"And therefore she lay in the dust
For after the first two thousand years,
which are the two thousand years of chaos,
there were the Mishkan and the Mishkan of Shiloh,
and the First Temple was built
and it stood seventy-two years of it.
and all the days of the Second Temple were in it.
And in the Gemara (Berachos 58a) it is expounded:
"'And the Hod' — this is the Holy Temple";
and in the end, in the fifth millennium,
which corresponds to the attribute of Hod,
then precisely, for the whole millennium,
And this is what is said:
(in the Ra'aya Mehemna on this parsha mentioned above):
"For Netzach and Hod — corresponding to them
the two on which the House rests;
That is, fire corresponds to Netzach,
for of Moshe Rabbeinu it is said:
"The face of Moshe was like the face of the sun" (Bava Basra 75a),
and the sun is of fire;
and he brought down the Written Torah,
the aspect of the Oral Torah,
the aspect of the Written Torah.
that it receives from the sun,
"And just as the moon is of light,
but receives light from the sun,
is a chariot for the attribute of Hod,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (שְׁמוֹת ד, טז; ז, א)
shall be a mouth for you";
"For the lips of the Kohen shall guard knowledge,
and Torah they shall seek from his mouth."
And in the end, in the fourth millennium,
which corresponds to the attribute of Netzach,
the two Temples stood for most of it;
and in the fifth millennium, which corresponds to Hod,
And upon this comes this consolation,
the fifth, which corresponds to Hod,
"For more are the children of the desolate one
than the children of the married one."
For precisely in the fifth millennium was
the main spread of the power
began the era of the Amoraim,
And likewise at the end of the fifth millennium
there lived Rabbeinu Tam and the Baalei HaTosafos,
in the Sefer HaKabbalah of the Raavad, of blessed memory.
And this is "for more are the children of the desolate one":

p: And likewise on the fifth day
of the seven days of Creation,
which corresponds to the attribute of Hod,
there is mentioned for the first time in the Torah
And the essence of life is the Torah,
"See, I have set before you life...
And this is what is said on the fifth day:
And Yisrael are likened to fish,
"Just as fish grow up in the water,
yet once a single drop comes down from above
they receive it with thirst, etc.,
so Yisrael grow up in the water,
as if they had never heard
words of Torah in their lives."
And likewise the attribute of Hod,
(as is written in the Tikkunim, Tikkun 13),
which is the aspect of the Oral Torah.
And this follows what they said
Moshe conducted himself with it generously
and gave it to Yisrael, etc.;
rather, it refers only to the pilpul";
for the pilpul of the Oral Torah
was given only to Moshe Rabbeinu,
and this is the attribute of Hod;
is a chariot for this attribute.
And this is what they said in the Gemara
"'And the Hod' — this is the Holy Temple";
and in light of what they said (Megillah 29a):
"'And I have been to them as a minor sanctuary' (Yechezkel 11:16):
this is the house of our master in Bavel";
who lived at the beginning of the fifth millennium;
the main spread of the Babylonian Talmud.
Now in the Gemara in Berachos mentioned above
this is the downfall of the wicked kingdom;
this is the war of the streams of Arnon;
this is the war of Sisera."
that they are the eternal ones,
in the holy Zohar (Parshas Ki Sisa);
for the eternity of Yisrael has no interruption
And the war of Sisera is mentioned,
But as for its expounding "and the Hod" as
the war of the streams of Arnon
and why is there no mention of
the war of the thirty-one kings?
דְּבַפָּסוּק נֶאֱמַר עַל זֶה (בְּמִדְבַּר כא, יד)
that in the pasuk it says about it (Bamidbar 21:14):
in the Book of the Wars of Hashem:
and they expounded in the Gemara (Berachos 54a–b)
that it was revealed through Es and Vahev;
"To Him Who smote great kings," etc.,
Could not, by the breath of His mouth,
a thousand times as many as they die?
as is written in the Gemara (Berachos 54b):
the mountains clung to one another
it says (in Rashi, from the Sifrei on Beha'alosecha; Rashi Bamidbar 10:33)
that the fragments of the Tablets were in it;
was in the middle of the camp.
And the fragments of the Tablets
דְּאָמַר לוֹ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ (שְׁמוֹת לד, א)
for Hashem Yisbarach said to him (Shemos 34:1):
And although he did this on his own judgment,
and it seemed at first glance
that he had not acted properly,
on the contrary, this brought about
"'In the book of the wars of Hashem'
a war that is through a book."
מִשֶּׁרַבּוּ תַּלְמִידֵי בֵּית שַׁמַּאי וּבֵית הִלֵּל
"Once the students of Beis Shammai and Beis Hillel multiplied
who had not served their teachers sufficiently,
so that the battle came about
עַל יְדֵי שֶׁלֹּא שִׁמְּשׁוּ כָּל צׇרְכָּן
because they had not served sufficiently
nevertheless it is "love at its end,"
עַל מַחֲלוֹקֶת בֵּית שַׁמַּאי וּבֵית הִלֵּל
about the dispute of Beis Shammai and Beis Hillel:
that they expounded in the Gemara (Berachos 54a):
at the end of the camp of Yisrael, etc.;
And this is as we have already said,
the husk of jealousy and anger;
to the point that they said about Gechazi
that he has no share in the World to Come
(as they said at the beginning of perek Chelek, Sanhedrin 90a),
since he is sent away forever
And here the miracle was revealed
And therefore "and the Hod" is expounded
of the aspect of the Oral Torah,
And so it is expounded afterward:
"'And the Hod' — this is the Holy Temple";
for in truth the Sanctuary stands
"And I have been to them as a minor sanctuary,"
for the Holy One, Blessed is He, has in His world
אֶלָּא ד׳ אַמּוֹת שֶׁל הֲלָכָה בִּלְבַד
only the four cubits of halachah,
And this is "for more are the children of the desolate one
than the children of the married one":
the bestowal of the aspect of the Oral Torah,
for Shabbos corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
we call it the Oral Torah" (Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a);
And therefore on it Yisrael have
"'and the Hod' — this is the Holy Temple,"
And Hashem Yisbarach looks only toward the good;
therefore all the consolations are read on Shabbos.
